un.id user_notice_id, un.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.content_format, n.notice_type, un.is_read, n.publish_time
mapper.select: select from sys_user_notice un inner join sys_notice n on n.id = un.notice_id where un.user_id = #{userId} and un.notice_id = #{noticeId}
select from sys_user_notice un inner join sys_notice n on n.id = un.notice_id where un.user_id = #{userId} and un.is_read = 0 and n.notice_type = 2 order by n.publish_time desc, n.id desc
